title: Balls
summary: Buy balls mid-run with Seashells (not while balls are bouncing). Each purchase rolls a rarity, then a ball of that rarity.

sections.title: Balls
sections.note: ATK is damage per hit. Charge is how much each hit adds to your Nikke’s skill gauge. Chance assumes balls of the same rarity are equally likely (the table only gives rarity odds).

rows.sub: Damages the blocks it hits. Hitting a block has a chance to trigger a fire that deals extra damage to both it and the blocks on all four sides. (ATK: 1)
Damages the blocks it hits. Hitting a block has a chance to trigger a shock that deals extra damage to both it and the blocks at each diagonal. (ATK: 1)
Damages the blocks it hits. Hitting a block has a chance to trigger an explosion that deals extra damage to it. (ATK: 2)
Damages the blocks it hits. Hitting a block has a chance to deal extra damage to its entire row. (ATK: 4)
Damages the blocks it hits. Hitting a block has a chance to deal extra damage to its entire column. (ATK: 4)
Damages the blocks it hits. Hitting a block has a chance to deal extra damage to both its entire row and its entire column. (ATK: 2)
